aequĭdĭci (sc. versus) [aequus-dico],
I.verses containing corresponding words or expressions (ἀντιθέτους), as (Verg. E. 2, 18): alba ligustra cadunt, vaccinia nigra leguntur: “Albis enim nigra opposuit, ligustris autem vaccinia attribuit, et cadentibus legenda assignavit,” Diom. p. 498 P.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
